title: Wild Ambush landing and shared overlap exit

verification.actor: One prepared, current WILD Weepinbell (species 70) with the authored Ambush conditional Attitude at Route 29 map 33.
verification.trigger: Place the player at (585,408), spawn Weepinbell at (583,406), then hold the player still without changing profile, condition, timers, collision, or actor state. Ambush condition 49529 must resolve PLAYER at an idle intent boundary.
verification.observable: Requirement current.ambush-player-tile-landing: the active timed Ambush condition and application 26 remain bound to the same Weepinbell. Its normal directed Hop targets and lands on the stationary player's exact tile (585,408), with complete rendered travel, one logical commit, motion finish, and control return. After real contact, normal Player knockback is allowed. The same full actor must overlap the Player at equal physical base Y, finish a native shared one-tile exit to a clear neighboring tile, and emit its next normal profile intent and START. Native accepted shared movement owns the unchanged profile-terrain and stock blocked-direction checks.

setupMutations.change: Use disposable test.sav, checked teleport, native Wild Weepinbell spawn, and exact bind. The observation window uses no profile, condition, timer, collision, position, or input mutation.
